subject: 辽金北方（11–13世纪）·净宽4格城门（原创扩展；匿名年代意象，非文物复原）
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise only the projected geometry of the supplied realistic northern Liao/Jin city gate. Keep exactly the same ancient materials, restrained grey roof, timber details, muted earthen walls, upper-left lighting, real RGBA transparency, one isolated sprite. No scenery or text.
There are two measurable problems to fix. FIRST: make both piers about20percent NARROWER on the long front facade, by moving their INNER faces outward towards the two external ends. Keep the exterior total facade width fixed. The empty central aperture must widen from about39percent to50percent of the total facade. Exact front sequence TWO units solid / FOUR units EMPTY / TWO units solid. Each pier is2 wide but4 deep. There is no floor across the aperture.
SECOND: increase the whole gate DEPTH by approximately20percent in screen horizontal span. The visible right side wall currently slopes too steeply upward-right. Set its ground edge slope to minus0.5, NOT minus0.64. Keep the long facade ground slope plus0.5. The two footprint directions need SYMMETRIC diagonal angles to horizontal, both26.565degrees. This is true 2:1 orthographic dimetric, yaw45 elevation30, with parallel edges and vertical upright columns. Physical outside plan8 wide by4 deep; screen horizontal length of the facade exactly TWICE that of the depth edge.
In a1254px square image ground contact corners should be LEFT(80,800), FRONT(820,1170), RIGHT(1190,985), hiddenREAR(450,615). The inside front feet lie at(265,892.5) and(635,1077.5). These coordinates describe the actual bottom masonry corners, not shadows; never draw construction lines, numbers, labels or marks. Set the roof and upper hall consistently over this deeper plan, so side roof broadens too. Keep entire roof and feet within frame and leave transparent margins. No human, modern elements, inscription, checkerboard, water, platform, stairs or background. Transparent clear opening through the full gate depth. ONE gate only.
negative: 无字、无人、无现代物、无背景、无厚地台、无假棋盘透明、无透视汇聚
